Beef Stroganoff | Instant Pot Recipes
By: A Kitchen Advisor
Published: Thursday, February 7, 2019 - 4:08pm

Ingredients




3 lbs top sirloin beef
1 onion
1 lb mushrooms
2 tbsp oil
1 tbsp salt
1/4 tsp black pepper
2 tbsp butter
1 tsp mustard
1/4 cup wine
3 cloves garlic
2 cups beef broth
1 red chili pepper
4 tbsp cornstarch
4 tbsp water
1 cup cream cheese
1 cup sour cream

Preparation

1 Slice the onion and the mushrooms. 2 Cut the beef into thin stripes. 3 Add salt, black pepper and stir well. 4 Select (Sauté) program to pre-heat the Instant Pot and then adjust the + or – buttons to set 30 minutes of cooking time. 5 Pour cooking oil into the inner pot. 6 Add butter and beef, stir well.  Sauté for 5 minutes. Don't overcook it, just brown the meat a little bit. 7 Remove the beef from the inner pot, add onion and Sauté for 2 minutes. 8 Add mushrooms, minced garlic, mustard and Sauté for 3 more minutes. 9 Bring back the beef, pour wine, beef broth and stir well. Deglaze (scrape) the bottom of the pot so nothing’s stuck to it. 10 Lastly, add chili pepper. 11 Cancel (Sauté) program. Close the lid. Turn the steam release handle on the lid to “Sealing” position. Select (Pressure cook) program and set time to 15 minutes. 12 When time is up, open the pressure cooker using Quick Release (let the steam escape instantly from the inner pot, turn the steam release handle on the lid to “Venting” position. 13 Open the lid, select (Sauté) program and set time to 5 minutes. 14 Add in the cornstarch dissolved in water, add cheese cream and sour cream. Stir immediately and thoroughly. 15 Good job,  delicious and easy Beef Stroganoff is ready now. It came out very flavorful and creamy. Enjoy!

Learn how to make easy Beef Stroganoff recipe in Instant Pot. This delicious recipe originally came from mid 19th century Russia and gained popularity around the world. First of all, you will both enjoy the creaminess of the gravy and tastefulness of the meat. There is no need to go to an expensive restaurant as you can make this yummy Instant Pot Recipe in the comfort of your own home.
Originally, it was a Russian dish of sautéed pieces of beef served in a sauce with sour cream called in Russian smetana. Beef Stroganoff recipe has become very popular around the world. There are a lot of significant variations from the original recipe. We make our own twist. Get prepared to please your taste buds with one of the most popular instant pot recipes.
As usual, there is an extra magic ingredient which gives additional tastefulness and aroma to Beef Stroganoff. Add your favorite wine and feel the difference. Certainly, wine will bring a splash of craving and flavor to your delicious dinner.
The best recipes for busy families is the motto of our website. With passion and creativity make yummy healthy dinner recipes in Instant Pot.
